column1: # GT-PCAP labels for fp-udp-5: the false-positive set's class (5) (D6, brief P4-4-HR2325S, deliverable 1). The builder's, from how each item was made; tshark's reading is reported beside them by hr23_tshark.py, never used as a label.

# one row per item, each on its own 5-tuple: src is the first sender. packets: the item's 1-based packet numbers. datagrams: the octets of each datagram, or for TCP each end's segments, c the client's and s the server's, a lost one in parentheses (its ACK is kept).
# header_at: per datagram, the offsets at which the item was built to hold a header whose CRC passes; - for none. No other offset holds one (the redraw rule; draws counts the draws it took).

# code and side: the function code a class (3b-data) or (3c) item's fragment carries, and the side it is sent from (orig: the first sender, by the design's section 1 item 1 with C0's likely_server_ports). dir: the link header's DIR bit as built.
